## Overview

Part of the [**Data Science Projects Collection**](https://github.com/PaulChanCyber/Data-Science-Project-) (Laptop price analysis)—Analyzes laptop listing prices vs. CPU, RAM, storage, and brand across retailers.

## Problem & Data

Consumers face opaque pricing across configurations and brands.

## Approach

Specification-based feature matrix, correlation analysis, clustering/segmentation, and price trend charts.

## Technologies

Python · pandas · Seaborn · Jupyter

## Outcomes

Specification–price benchmarks and brand premium estimates.
